sentences.text: Kerplunk is the second studio album by American punk rock band Green Day , released on December 17 , 1991 by Lookout !	Green Day	Green Day	Lookout	Lookout Records	punk rock	punk rock
Records .
Kerplunk was Green Day 's last release on the Lookout Records label , and was also the first album to feature Tré Cool on drums .	Green Day	Green Day	Lookout	Lookout Records	Tré Cool	Tré Cool
The album sold 10,000 copies its first day and became Lookout !	Lookout	Lookout Records
's biggest selling release .

After debuting it to their fans in the Berkeley , California area and receiving much approval from the critical 924 Gilman Street crowd , the band packed up in a cramped , converted Book Mobile and headed east .	California	California	924 Gilman Street	924 Gilman Street	Book Mobile	Book Mobile
Green Day developed a fan base on the east coast behind the touring support of grassroots promoter , Jak Werz .	Green Day	Green Day	Jak Werz	Jak Werz
The opportunity paid off as album sales reached over 50,000 copies .
Along with the successful live shows , major labels took notice of Kerplunk '' 's phenomenal popularity , as a result , many approached the band .
Green Day realized that they had outgrown their record distribution capacity with Lookout !	Green Day	Green Day	Lookout	Lookout Records
and eventually signed with Reprise Records .	Reprise Records	Reprise Records
With Reprise , Green Day recorded and released their next album Dookie -LRB- 1994 -RRB- .	Green Day	Green Day	Dookie	Dookie

The album officially includes only 12 tracks , but the versions released on CD and cassette also include the 4 tracks from the Sweet Children EP .	CD	Compact disc	cassette	Compact Cassette	Sweet Children	Sweet Children (EP)
One of those tracks is a cover of The Who 's `` My Generation '' .	The Who	The Who	My Generation	My Generation (The Who song)
In August 2005 , Green Day pulled the album , as well as all of their other material released through the Lookout !	Green Day	Green Day	Lookout	Lookout Records
label due to unpaid royalties .
It was reissued on CD by Reprise Records , who Green Day has been with since leaving Lookout !	Green Day	Green Day	Lookout	Lookout Records	Reprise Records	Reprise Records	CD	Compact disc
, on January 9 , 2007 .
In Europe , the album was released by Epitaph Europe , and has remained in print .	Epitaph Europe	Epitaph Records

It was reissued on vinyl on March 24 , 2009 by Reprise Records and includes a reissue of the Sweet Children EP .	Reprise Records	Reprise Records	Sweet Children	Sweet Children (EP)	vinyl	Gramophone record

There were no official singles released from the album , although `` 2000 Light Years Away '' and `` Christie Road '' were released as mock-up singles in a Green Day singles box set entitled Green Day : Ultimate Collectors .	Green Day	Green Day
As of November 2013 , Kerplunk '' has sold more than 1,000,000 copies in the United States and more than 4,000,000 copies worldwide .	United States	United States
The album has gone on to be among the best selling independently released albums of all time .
